text: Every word in the K1 to K3 solutions, plus the 2025 words, was turned into a keyword alphabet: 102 tables, 10,404 pairs, three ways of using them, secret words of length 1 to 52.
Drawn for SHADING and INVISIBLE: places 22 and 29 are seven apart, so a 7-letter word gives them the same key letter, and they need different ones.
At every length the copper has about as many consistent settings as a shuffled copper, and no forced pattern matches a puzzle word: the bigger vocabulary changes nothing.
